themes.name: Enterprise Software

To consolidate business processes and displace legacy CRM competitors, the company dedicates its R&D budget toward making its platform AI-native while acquiring adjacent solutions like Veza, Armis, Moveworks, and Logik. themes.name: Agentic AI
themes.description: Autonomous AI systems that execute multi-step tasks, use tools/software, and make decisions with limited human oversight.

linked_companies.name: MICROSOFT CORP
linked_companies.description: Drives the advancement of autonomous AI systems by integrating agentic capabilities into its enterprise software suite through Copilot and providing the foundational cloud infrastructure for developers to build and deploy custom AI agents.
linked_companies.evidence: Microsoft is engineering a structural transition into the "agentic computing era," explicitly positioning autonomous agents as the successor to traditional applications and the future dominant workload across its cloud infrastructure. Moving beyond synchronous assistance, the company has integrated Agent Mode as the default experience within its core Microsoft 365 Copilot applications to enable the asynchronous execution of long-running workflows. This integration is supported by newly deployed enterprise infrastructure, including the Foundry Agent Service for stateful orchestration and the Agent 365 control plane, which currently manages tens of millions of agents utilized by over 90% of Fortune 500 organizations. These agentic capabilities are generating direct commercial outcomes, evidenced by LinkedIn's agent-based products surpassing a $450 million annualized revenue run rate and prebuilt Dynamics 365 agents delivering a 30% reduction in issue resolution times for clients like HSBC.

linked_companies.name: NVIDIA CORP
linked_companies.description: Powers the development and deployment of autonomous AI agents by providing advanced graphics processing units and comprehensive software frameworks optimized for complex artificial intelligence workloads.
linked_companies.evidence: NVIDIA addresses the Agentic AI theme through the recent launch of Vera, the world's first CPU purpose-built to orchestrate autonomous, multi-step AI agents. Identifying the industry transition from one-shot inference to reasoning workflows as a new growth inflection point, the company targets a $200 billion total addressable market, forecasts nearly $20 billion in near-term CPU revenue, and recently restructured its Edge Computing reporting framework to explicitly capture agentic devices. This multi-billion dollar hardware capability builds directly upon foundational investments from earlier in the year, including a $10 billion partnership focused on Anthropic's Claude Cowork platform and the company-wide deployment of agentic co-design partners across NVIDIA's own engineering workforce.

linked_companies.name: UIPATH INC - CLASS A
linked_companies.description: Integrates artificial intelligence into its enterprise automation platform to deploy autonomous agents capable of executing and managing complex business workflows.
linked_companies.evidence: UiPath defines its core platform as "agentic first," pioneering a strategic evolution from rule-based execution to intelligent, agentic automation. This technological shift is anchored by the recent general availability of agentic products—including coding, healing, and diagnostic agents—and the $190 million acquisition of WorkFusion to expand its autonomous solutions portfolio. The integration of proprietary AI agents with deterministic automation directly impacts the company's financials, driving its largest expansion deals, featuring in the vast majority of its top transactions, and fueling nearly $200 million in AI product annual recurring revenue. To further scale these enterprise workflows, UiPath deploys dedicated professional services personnel and has established targeted ecosystem partnerships with Salesforce and Deloitte.

linked_companies.name: C3.AI INC-A
linked_companies.description: Develops enterprise AI applications and generative AI platforms that enable the deployment of autonomous agents to automate complex reasoning, retrieve data, and execute multi-step workflows across diverse business systems.
linked_companies.evidence: C3.ai establishes Agentic AI as its core technology architecture through the C3 Agentic AI Platform, which underpins the subscription software generating 90% of the company's total revenue as of early fiscal 2026. Redirecting R&D resources toward autonomous systems, the company launched C3 AI Agentic Process Automation and a Deep Research Agent in September 2025 to merge rules-based workflows with multi-agent reasoning capabilities. The company secures its proprietary framework with foundational U.S. patent No. 12,111,859, awarded in October 2024, which covers its generative AI agentic technology and the AI Orchestrator used to coordinate independent, multimodal AI agents across enterprise processes.

linked_companies.name: SOUNDHOUND AI INC-A
linked_companies.description: Develops conversational artificial intelligence platforms that power autonomous voice agents capable of executing tasks, processing natural language, and automating customer interactions across the automotive, hospitality, and smart device sectors.
linked_companies.evidence: SoundHound's strategic direction is anchored by the launch of its Orchestrated Agent System (OASYS), a foundational platform where AI autonomously builds and refines entire fleets of AI agents to execute complex workflows. The company is actively restructuring to merge acquired teams into this single ecosystem, deploying new capabilities across enterprise partnerships and consumer touchpoints, such as voice commerce in connected vehicles. This technological transformation builds upon earlier capital deployments, most explicitly the $76.1 million acquisition of Interactions Corporation, which expanded the workforce dedicated to scaling SoundHound's proprietary Agentic Plus framework. By transitioning its architecture to chain targeted actions into fully autonomous customer service resolutions, the company establishes agentic platforms as the core infrastructure driving its product development and revenue strategy.
